markdown_report:
**Evidence and insights.** The starting protocol offers three insights. First, macro HR@10 weights all four categories equally; Electronics-only gains cannot determine selection. Second, Electronics has 10.71% negative-over-positive errors and a −0.0749 tenth-percentile margin. These support a discrimination hypothesis without establishing its cause. Third, simulator feedback identifies broad associations and overlooked connector/format distinctions. Titles may expose these distinctions, but cannot establish compatibility, satisfaction or fulfilled needs.

The literature offers three further insights. [HSTU](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.17152) supports learned sequential interactions; preserve its backbone. [AttrFormer](https://doi.org/10.1145/3690624.3709267) and [MARS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.00702) motivate attribute-sensitive representations, without validating scratch-trained text here. [Kim](https://aclanthology.org/D14-1181/) establishes ordered local convolutions; global pooling discards relationships between detected windows. HSTU’s [sampled-softmax configuration](https://github.com/meta-recsys/generative-recommenders/blob/main/configs/ml-1m/hstu-sampled-softmax-n128-final.gin) motivates separate objective experiments; changing sampling simultaneously would obscure representation effects.

**Framework.** Organize experiments along item specificity, current-intent selection and ranking discrimination. Corresponding mechanisms are ordered text encoding, internal recency bias and sampled objectives. The central gap is whether these mechanisms improve held-out ranking and user-perceived usefulness together.

**Candidate assessment.** Scores are 0–10; higher difficulty means greater implementation burden. Each cell includes positive and negative considerations. Alignment scores express diagnostic hypotheses.

| Atomic idea | Originality | Potential | User alignment | Model alignment | Difficulty |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A: Ordered text residual | 5: targeted integration; established encoders | 7: transferable specificity; sparse supervision | 8: specificity and attributes; compatibility unverified | 7: finer discrimination; cause uncertain | 6: compact module; controls and deployment parity |
| B: Learned positional recency bias | 3: direct adaptation; HSTU precedent | 6: current intent; coarse proxy | 6: recent purpose; redundancy unresolved | 5: reduces stale evidence; errors unexplained | 3: small change; masking care |
| C: More uniform training negatives | 2: established objective; limited novelty | 6: stronger ranking signal; greater cost | 4: sharper relevance; attributes implicit | 8: targets separation; margins imperfect | 4: simple loss; memory growth |

**Selected idea: A, ordered text residual.** At 0% progress, retain this compact extension. It targets broad thematic substitutions and overlooked connector/format distinctions, while testing Electronics’ weak separation. Originality 5 and potential 7 remain provisional; difficulty rises to 6 for reproducible masking, controls and predictor consistency.

Use jointly learned token embeddings, width-3/5 convolutions and masked max pooling. Choose boundary padding so short fields contribute; pool only outputs centered on real tokens and zero empty fields. Fuse text into tied HSTU item vectors through one learned gate, retaining the baseline objective.

Prioritize baseline versus A; budget permitting, compare identical-CNN mean pooling, matched-capacity token-mean encoding and separately retrained shuffled-text controls. Brand/popularity shortcuts remain plausible; perturbation sensitivity cannot establish understanding.

Retain fixed seeds, splits, four routes, ≤200 epochs, 200 batches/epoch and one checkpoint/category. Report category and macro HR@10 against 99 unique negatives, paired differences and conditional bootstrap intervals. Disclose all search attempts: intervals do not remove selection bias. [Sampled ranking](https://research.google/pubs/on-sampled-metrics-for-item-recommendation/) need not track full-catalog quality. No new result is claimed.

idea.description: Add one jointly trained, order-sensitive title/description residual to the corrected HSTU item representation. Preserve the HSTU backbone and use exactly one independently trained model/checkpoint per category. The hypothesis addresses two supplied user failures—broad thematic substitutions and overlooked connector/format distinctions—and the measured weak positive–negative separation in Electronics. Local token order supplies a testable representation hypothesis, not verified attribute reasoning or physical compatibility.
idea.motivation: The simulator identifies specificity failures that item-ID histories may not resolve reliably. A local convolution can distinguish token positions within a window, whereas token-mean pooling discards that information. Electronics’ 10.71% wrong-rank rate, −0.0749 tenth-percentile margin and 16.36% small-margin rate motivate testing discrimination. These observations do not establish that text is the cause. Global max pooling also loses positions and relative order between detected windows, so the extension cannot promise long-range connector direction, number–unit binding, fulfilled-need detection or fewer redundant purchases. Keep the recency and negative-count ideas as separate alternatives rather than combining interventions before their effects are understood.
idea.implementation_notes:
STATUS AND FIXED PROTOCOL. This is a proposed experiment, not executed training or a measured improvement. Extend the supplied corrected baseline rather than reconstructing an unspecified replacement. Retain DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, all four dataset routes, supplied splits, single-GPU execution, maximum 200 epochs and exactly 200 batches per executed epoch. Honor the host SASREC_EPOCHS default of 200 despite its name. Save artifacts beneath the trial directory. Account for every attempted training, diagnostic and failed run within the shared 43,200 GPU-second budget; record preprocessing wall time separately as well. Never read hidden test files, other trials or their checkpoints. No external datasets or pretrained weights are permitted.

TEXT INPUTS. Use only permitted titles/descriptions from the supplied training-side metadata. Do not use generic example fields for reviews, ratings, prices, stores or item categories; simulator traits are unobserved. Fix and record the metadata scope before training. For a reproducible initial tokenizer, preserve case and use the Unicode regex \d+(?:\.\d+)?|[^\W\d_]+|[^\w\s]. This separates letter and number spans while retaining decimal numbers and punctuation tokens: USB-C and 12 V remain ordered sequences. This is a mechanical encoding, not a unit parser. Apply the same tokenizer at training and prediction. Reserve PAD=0 and UNK=1; retain tokens appearing in at least two permitted item documents, cap the remaining vocabulary at 50,000, and order by descending document frequency with lexical ties. Count each token once per item document combining title and description. Truncate titles to the first 32 tokens and descriptions to the first 96; right-pad these text fields. Record missing fields explicitly. Case preservation may increase sparsity, and truncation can remove decisive evidence; report coverage, UNK rates and truncation rates rather than claiming complete attribute preservation.

ORDERED ENCODER. Use one shared 32-dimensional token embedding with padding_idx=0 and separate title/description convolution banks. For each field, use Conv1d branches of widths 3 and 5, each with 32 output channels, stride 1, bias enabled, symmetric zero padding of 1 and 2 respectively, followed by GELU. Explicitly zero masked input embeddings. Choose boundary-padded semantics: an output is eligible for pooling exactly when its center token is real, even if its window touches padding. Mask other outputs with negative infinity before global max pooling; replace an entirely invalid branch with zeros before further arithmetic. This allows short nonempty fields to contribute and differs from strict complete-window masking. Concatenate the four 32-dimensional branch outputs and use a bias-free Linear(128, baseline_item_dimension) projection. Force the projected residual to zero when both fields are missing. The alternative strict-window method is a separate hypothesis and must not silently replace this convention.

FUSION AND SCORING. Define joint_item(i) = item_emb(i) + sigmoid(g) * text_projection(i), with one learned scalar gate initialized to -3. Force joint_item(0)=0 and keep the token PAD row zero. Tie joint_item across sequence inputs and candidate scoring, preserving all baseline feature normalization, scaling and score conventions. The text encoder, item embeddings, gate and HSTU are optimized jointly with the corrected baseline objective. Do not add a separately fitted text scorer. Preserve the corrected HSTU depth, width, attention, causal masks, sampler, loss, optimizer, learning-rate schedule, dropout and sequence length. Record their actual host-supplied values in the experiment manifest before execution. The gated residual can change score norms; measure item-vector norms and their association with training popularity before attributing gains to semantics.

PRIMARY COMPARISON AND CONTROLS. Prespecify corrected baseline versus ordered text residual as the primary exploratory comparison. Every condition trains its own independent category models, and only the selected condition is deployed; never combine their predictions. Before launching a condition, estimate whether all four category runs and required checks fit the remaining budget. If controls are unaffordable, disclose them as omitted. Prioritize identical-CNN max versus masked-mean pooling to isolate pooling with identical parameter capacity. For mean pooling, sum only eligible center outputs and divide by their count, returning zero for empty fields. A token-mean MLP control tests whether local convolutions help beyond field means: use the same token embeddings and gate, concatenate the two 32-dimensional field means, and choose the MLP hidden width to minimize the absolute trainable-parameter difference from the convolution-plus-projection module; report actual counts and any mismatch. Do not attribute a comparison solely to order when capacity differs.

SHORTCUT CONTROLS. Budget permitting, retrain an identical CNN on a fixed within-field token permutation for each item, generated once with a dedicated RNG seed 42 and traversed in sorted item-ID order. This preserves token counts and field lengths but is not a clean semantic null: local coincidences and distributional correlations remain. A distinct alignment control permutes whole title/description pairs between items within training-interaction-count deciles and text-length quartiles, keeping title/description availability patterns separate. Define quantile assignment and tie handling in the manifest; leave singleton strata unchanged and report how many items are actually reassigned. Fit and freeze these perturbations using training-side information only, then retrain. Inference-only corruption instead measures distribution-shift sensitivity. Brand-masked retraining is deferred unless a reproducible brand lexicon derived solely from permitted text can be specified without unsupported brand labels. Missingness/length-only and shuffled alignment controls can expose shortcuts but do not prove their absence. Do not claim a first-of-kind protocol.

PERTURBATION CHECKS. Inspect a prespecified, training-side set of titles containing explicit direction words or number–unit spans. Record original text, exact edit, tokenization and score changes. Contrast connector reversals or quantity substitutions with manually documented meaning-preserving rewrites where such rewrites are defensible. Do not train on fabricated recommendation labels or assume edited products exist. These probes measure scorer sensitivity and invariance, not true compatibility, user preference or label-flipping accuracy. Local width-5 features may still fail on longer relations.

VALIDATION AND SELECTION. Preserve the host validation frequency and checkpoint rule and record them before training. If the host leaves ties unspecified, prefer the earliest checkpoint; do not override an existing rule. Select using the fixed four-category macro validation HR@10, never Electronics alone or diagnostic margins. Report each category and the equally weighted macro mean explicitly as HR@10 against 99 unique sampled negatives, with 200 validation users/category and evaluation seed 42. One additional hit changes its category HR by 0.5 percentage points and macro HR by 0.125 percentage points. If host-provided paired per-user hits are available, report absolute differences in percentage points and discordant counts. Bootstrap 200 users with replacement within each category, keeping both models' outcomes paired for the same users and pinned candidate sets; average the four category differences. Use 10,000 replicates, a dedicated analysis RNG seed 42 and percentile 95% intervals. Do not regenerate candidates or alter the evaluator. These intervals describe conditional user-sampling uncertainty, excluding training-seed, new-candidate and new-category variability; fixed-benchmark differences remain descriptive. They do not remove adaptive selection optimism. Disclose every attempted configuration, inspected checkpoint, selection frequency, stopping rule and search trajectory. Reserve confirmatory claims for the host's untouched final evaluation. Sampled HR@10 does not establish full-catalog superiority or quality for the twenty simulator users.

DIAGNOSTIC CONTRACT. Preserve item_emb as the ID embedding module and distinguish its diagnostics from joint item-vector diagnostics. Keep log2feats(sequence), predict_score(features, items), the host ModelView interfaces, view.model as the actual trained nn.Module, DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis). The diagnosis method returns metrics and metric_definitions; the interpretation prompt uses those measured values and definitions. Compute operational margins through the actual scorer. The loader remains (None, sequence, positive, negative), with B x L tensors; retain the family-specific sample_batch behavior. Leave unavailable category breakdowns unavailable. The supplied mapped cosine values near 0.5 imply near-zero average cosine, not established collapse. Raw margins depend on score scale and cannot alone establish better ranking; track wrong-rank rates alongside margins and validation results.

CHECKPOINT AND PREDICTOR. For left-padded sequence readout, use the maximum nonzero position index and explicitly preserve the baseline empty-sequence convention; never use nonpadding_count-1. Save one selected checkpoint/category containing learned parameters, architecture configuration, vocabulary, tokenizer specification, fixed token tensors and masks. Update the embedded predictor writer with the identical encoder, padding semantics, fusion, scoring and four-category routing. Each route loads exactly one independently trained model/checkpoint. Verify training/reloaded score parity in evaluation mode on the same permitted examples and candidate IDs, including short text, missing text, left-padded histories and the baseline empty-history case. Use the baseline dtype and document a numerical tolerance appropriate to it. No ensembles, checkpoint averaging, independently fitted experts, transition/popularity score fusion or other-trial checkpoint reuse is permitted. Repeat permitted full-catalog qualitative assessment for the twenty training users if available; otherwise the proposed user-facing improvements remain unverified hypotheses.
idea.pseudocode:
CONFIG = preserve_corrected_baseline_configuration()
CONFIG.preprocessing_seed = 0
CONFIG.training_seed = 42
CONFIG.epochs = min(host_configured_epochs(default=200), 200)
CONFIG.batches_per_epoch = 200
DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR']
record_actual_baseline_settings_and_fixed_selection_rule(CONFIG)
prespecify_primary_comparison_and_budget_order()

# Execute a condition only if all four category runs and checks fit the budget.
for condition in authorized_budgeted_conditions:
    for category in FOUR_SUPPLIED_ROUTES:
        seed_training_rngs(42)
        histories, metadata = load_supplied_training_inputs(category)
        tokens, masks, tokenizer_state = encode_permitted_titles_descriptions(
            metadata, recorded_regex, min_document_frequency=2,
            vocabulary_cap=50000, title_length=32, description_length=96)
        apply_only_prespecified_training_side_control_if_requested(condition)
        model = extend_corrected_HSTU_if_text_enabled(CONFIG, tokens, masks)

        # Internal text computation, with title/description processed separately:
        # x = token_embedding(tokens) * mask
        # for width in [3, 5]:
        #     a = GELU(conv(x, symmetric_padding=(width-1)//2))
        #     valid_output = mask at each output center
        #     branch = masked_max(a, valid_output)
        #     branch = zero for rows with no valid centers
        # text = bias_free_projection(concatenate_four_branches())
        # text = zero when both fields are missing
        # joint_item = item_emb + sigmoid(g_initialized_to_minus_3) * text
        # joint_item[0] = 0; use the same representation for inputs and scoring.

        for epoch in range(CONFIG.epochs):
            for batch_index in range(200):
                sequence, positive, negative = family_specific_sample_batch(histories)
                features = model.log2feats(sequence)
                loss = corrected_baseline_loss(
                    features, positive, negative, scorer=model.predict_score)
                update_single_network_with_baseline_optimizer(loss)
            apply_unchanged_host_validation_and_checkpoint_rule()
            log_training_diagnostic_and_failed_run_GPU_seconds()
            enforce_shared_remaining_budget_without_changing_required_batches()

        save_one_selected_checkpoint_with_architecture_and_text_assets(category)
        run_family_compatible_diagnosis_returning_metrics_and_definitions()

    write_embedded_predictor_with_identical_model_and_four_routes()
    verify_reload_score_parity_on_permitted_edge_cases()
    collect_host_category_and_macro_validation_HR_at_10()
    record_condition_and_complete_search_trajectory()

# Prediction loads exactly one checkpoint for the requested category.
features = model.log2feats(left_padded_sequence)
last_index = maximum_nonzero_position_or_baseline_empty_case(left_padded_sequence)
scores = model.predict_score(features_at(last_index), candidate_items)

# Analysis uses only host-provided validation outcomes.
if paired_per_user_hits_available:
    report_category_macro_differences_and_discordant_counts()
    paired_within_category_bootstrap(replicates=10000, analysis_seed=42)
report_omitted_controls_selection_bias_and_sampled_metric_limitations()
# Do not combine predictors, invent user outcomes or access hidden tests.

originality.positive: A targeted integration of ordered text features into one HSTU addresses diagnosed specificity failures, with controls separating pooling, item–text alignment and local order.
originality.negative: Convolutional encoders, gated residuals and attribute-aware recommendation are established. The contribution is a controlled benchmark adaptation; neither architectural priority nor a first-of-kind evaluation protocol is established.

future_potential.positive: Offers a feasible path to investigating item specificity without pretrained weights and can motivate more explicit attribute relationships if ranking and user evidence support it.
future_potential.negative: Sparse supervision may favor brand, popularity or metadata shortcuts. Local convolution and sampled HR@10 may fail to improve compatibility, current usefulness or full-catalog recommendations.

code_difficulty.positive: The primary extension is a compact internal module that preserves HSTU and avoids negative-mining infrastructure or an additional inference predictor.
code_difficulty.negative: Reproducible text assets, exact padding semantics, tied scoring, diagnostic adaptation, retrained controls, budget management and embedded-predictor parity make the complete experiment substantially harder than adding a CNN.

related_work.title: Actions Speak Louder than Words: Trillion-Parameter Sequential Transducers for Generative Recommendations
contributions: Introduces HSTU as a sequential recommendation backbone.
Provides the family-preserving foundation for the proposed internal item-representation extension.
limitations: Does not establish that the proposed scratch-trained ordered text residual improves this four-category benchmark.
Sequential and temporal mechanisms do not directly establish physical compatibility or fulfilled needs.

related_work.title: AttrFormer
contributions: The supplied search summary describes explicit categorical and numerical attribute relations for sequential recommendation.
Motivates retaining attribute distinctions rather than reducing all text to broad similarity.
limitations: Generic structured ratings, prices, stores and item categories are unavailable in this task.
Does not validate reliable compatibility extraction from the permitted titles/descriptions.

related_work.title: MARS
contributions: The supplied search summary describes multiple attribute-aware text representations and attribute-level interest matching.
Supports investigating specificity beyond one pooled text vector.
limitations: Its pretrained language representations are outside the permitted setup.
Transfer to a compact encoder trained from scratch remains an experimental hypothesis.

related_work.title: Official HSTU sampled-softmax configuration
contributions: Supplies an HSTU example using 128 negatives, normalized embeddings and temperature 0.05.
Motivates a separate future objective ablation within the same model family.
limitations: A MovieLens configuration does not establish optimal Amazon hyperparameters.
Changing normalization, temperature or sampling during the selected representation experiment would confound attribution.

related_work.title: Convolutional Neural Networks for Sentence Classification
contributions: Establishes ordered contiguous word-window convolutions followed by max-over-time pooling.
Provides a direct precedent for the proposed compact local text encoder.
limitations: Global pooling discards the positions and relative order of detected windows.
Sentence-classification results do not establish recommendation gains, compatibility reasoning or success with scratch-trained embeddings here.

related_work.title: AllenNLP CNN encoder implementation
contributions: Provides an implementation precedent for masked embeddings and excluding invalid convolution windows before pooling.
Highlights the need to specify convolution-window validity explicitly.
limitations: Its stricter valid-window convention differs from the selected boundary-padded convention.
Length-based masking assumptions must not be copied into arbitrary or left-padded inputs without checking actual token masks.

related_work.title: A Sensitivity Analysis of (and Practitioners' Guide to) Convolutional Neural Networks for Sentence Classification
contributions: Compares pooling choices while holding convolution architecture fixed.
Motivates identical-CNN max-versus-mean pooling controls.
limitations: Uses a different task and pretrained embeddings.
Does not establish superiority over a parameter-matched token-mean encoder inside HSTU.

related_work.title: Leveraging Large Language Models for Sequential Recommendation: supplementary analysis
contributions: The supplied search summary reports degraded performance after permuting pretrained embeddings between items.
Motivates retrained item–text alignment controls and scrutiny of brand relationships.
limitations: Uses pretrained representations and a different backbone.
Does not isolate attribute semantics from brand cues or validate scratch-trained text encoders.

related_work.title: Out of Order
contributions: The supplied summary reports that many BERT predictions survive word shuffling.
Motivates caution when interpreting order sensitivity as semantic understanding.
limitations: Studies a different model and task.
Shuffling does not provide a clean semantic null for this recommendation experiment.

related_work.title: Word Order Does Matter
contributions: Identifies residual order information and distributional correlations in shuffled-training controls.
Supports documenting precisely what a token-shuffling control preserves.
limitations: Does not establish the behavior of the selected word-token CNN.
A shuffled control alone cannot prove or disprove attribute understanding.

related_work.title: NumPert
contributions: Provides an adjacent precedent for controlled numerical perturbations.
Motivates separating meaningful numerical edits from defensible meaning-preserving changes.
limitations: Evaluates fact-checking rather than recommendation.
Edited recommendation text has no established preference or compatibility label in this task.

related_work.title: A Comparison of Statistical Significance Tests for Information Retrieval Evaluation
contributions: Provides retrieval-comparison methodology informing paired analysis.
Motivates preserving paired user outcomes when estimating conditional uncertainty.
limitations: The proposed stratified four-category bootstrap is a task-specific adaptation.
Intervals exclude training and candidate-sampling variability and do not remove adaptive model-selection bias.

related_work.title: On Over-fitting in Model Selection and Subsequent Selection Bias in Performance Evaluation
contributions: Explains how repeated model selection can overfit evaluation noise.
Supports disclosing search trajectories and distinguishing exploratory validation from untouched final evaluation.
limitations: Does not supply additional data or eliminate the benchmark's restricted validation size.
Ordinary post-selection bootstrap intervals do not correct the selection process.

related_work.title: On Sampled Metrics for Item Recommendation
contributions: Shows that sampled ranking metrics can disagree with full-catalog rankings.
Supports labeling the pinned metric explicitly and separating it from full-catalog qualitative assessment.
limitations: Does not justify modifying the host evaluator.
Does not determine which candidate model will perform best under this fixed benchmark.
